setup_guide.introduction: Try the included street-corner scan or choose your own registered PLY. Conversion runs on a Linux x86-64 computer with an NVIDIA GPU and at least 48 GiB of GPU memory.

sample.description: Use the small synthetic SLIM-style street corner.
sample.expected_output: An OpenUSD scene and a web preview you can rotate and zoom.

real.introduction: Choose one registered PLY point cloud with coordinates in metres and Z up.
